build_MaskData: build a MaskData object to store and filter batched mask data with tensors and numpy arrays
generate_crop_boxes: generate a list of crop boxes at multiple layers with configurable overlap ratio for image segmentation
calculate_stability_score: calculate the stability score IoU between high and low thresholded binary masks for a batch
remove_small_regions: remove small disconnected regions or holes from a binary mask using connected components analysis
batched_mask_to_box: calculate bounding boxes in XYXY format around a batch of binary masks returning zero boxes for empty masks
